todo_line: - [ ] 008F Introduce and focused-test one fresh-authorized invitation context query with club-member collection, current member, Person and manage-members interests, composed from existing read APIs and independent of LiveView transient form state.

validation.evidence: 66 tests, 0 failures; covers the new invitation query, accepted authorization-query pattern, current invitation page, and committed read-model source adapter.

notes: Added the :member_invitation descriptor on :invitation_context with stable club_id and authenticated_email inputs and exactly selected_club, current_member, and active_member_count in its result. Every load normalizes identity, rereads active clubs, resolves the current Person and selected-club member by Person ID, counts the existing active-member read result, and rechecks manage-members permission. Focused proof covers normalized primary and attached-email identity, count entry/exit, selected membership and permission loss, fail-closed missing/invalid/inactive/foreign/unresolved contexts, and exclusion of invitation/form/error/resend/delivery/command/route/flash/navigation state. Interests are club, club_members, exact membership, current person, exact person_club, exact member_roles/member_permissions, and same-club club_roles/club_permissions; accepted adapter events map respectively from Club, Membership, Person, and Role projectors. Actual event structs prove selected-club membership, current Person, exact role/permission, and same-club permission matches while unrelated Club, Person, membership, and role scopes do not. The same Person's Membership change in another club stays isolated because no person_clubs interest is registered. The initial TDD run failed as expected with 7 tests and 7 failures because the query module was absent; the implementation then passed all focused checks. Implementation changes are limited to the two reported code/test paths: no LiveView wiring, existing query, adapter, package, read API, projector, schema, command, event, route, plan, todo, matrix, ADR, acceptance feature, or other delivery metadata changed, and task 008F remains unchecked.
